patch_description: This crossover version blends the strongest ideas from the prior programs while directly targeting the main failure mode: train-to-validation slope collapse caused by regime-specific features. The feature set is shifted toward shorter lookbacks, rolling z-score normalization, volatility/efficiency trend features, and a small number of robust multiplicative interactions. I also keep the model compact and regularized enough to generalize across regime shifts, while avoiding excessive collapse toward the mean by not over-regularizing too aggressively. The resulting feature matrix stays comfortably below the 80-feature limit and uses only past information.
